standard-dialogue.npc: The name's Gordon. Good day to you.

standard-dialogue.player: It's a nice farm you've got here.

standard-dialogue.npc: Thank you. We built it ourselves.

standard-dialogue.player: Really? So you haven't been here long?

standard-dialogue.npc: Nope. Not too long ago you couldn't safely travel around these parts. Too many lizardmen. But then some Hosidius explorers discovered how fertile this land was.
Lord Hosidius made a deal with Lord Shayzien and the lizardmen were cleared out to make room for the Farming Guild.
When we heard, we decided to come up here and start up our own farm.

options.text: Very nice. Well I hope it goes well for you.

steps.player: Very nice. Well I hope it goes well for you.

steps.npc: Thank you friend. See you later.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-rece.npc: Hello there. Not too bad, thanks.

options.text: Great to hear. All the best.

steps.player: Great to hear. All the best.

steps.npc: Thank you friend. See you later.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-getti.text: If the player received a 3,000 coins reward from the quest:

steps.npc: Hello again. Thank you for dealing with that beast.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-getti.text: If the player didn't receive a 3,000 coins reward from the quest:

steps.npc: Hello again. Thank you for dealing with that beast. As promised, here's your reward.
